Create a complete Blazor application called “Service Desk Mini”.

This is a small but polished internal support ticket app. It should feel interactive, modern, and demo-ready, not like a basic sample.

Main hard rule:
Use Ignite UI for Blazor components as the primary UI implementation. Do not build the main UI with plain HTML tables, plain inputs, custom SVG charts, Bootstrap-only components, or unrelated third-party UI components when an Ignite UI for Blazor component is available.

Use Ignite UI for Blazor components for:
- Ticket grids
- Dashboard charts
- Forms and inputs
- Dropdowns/selects
- Date inputs where needed
- Dialogs/modals
- Buttons
- Cards or panels
- Badges/chips/status indicators
- Toast/snackbar notifications

Use mock data only. Do not create a backend. Persist data in LocalStorage.

The app must have exactly 2 pages:

1. Dashboard
- KPI cards:
  - Total tickets
  - Open tickets
  - High priority tickets
  - Resolved tickets
- Chart: tickets by status
- Chart: tickets by priority
- Recent tickets grid
- Small “needs attention” section showing urgent or overdue tickets
- Dashboard must update when ticket data changes

2. Tickets
- Ticket grid with at least 25 mock tickets
- Columns:
  - Ticket ID
  - Title
  - Customer
  - Assignee
  - Priority
  - Status
  - Created date
  - Due date
- Search by title, customer, assignee, or ticket ID
- Filter by status
- Filter by priority
- Filter by assignee
- Sort columns
- Use pagination
- Add ticket
- Edit ticket
- Delete ticket
- Assign ticket
- Change ticket status
- View ticket details

Ticket statuses:
- New
- In Progress
- Waiting
- Resolved
- Closed

Ticket priorities:
- Low
- Medium
- High
- Critical

Validation:
- Title is required
- Customer is required
- Assignee is required
- Priority is required
- Status is required
- Created date is required
- Due date is required
- Due date cannot be before created date

Theme requirement:
Create a strong, consistent custom theme. The app should look modern and cool.

Use this design direction:
- Primary color: dark navy or deep indigo
- Accent color: electric blue, cyan, or teal
- Background: soft light gray
- Cards/surfaces: clean white
- Critical priority: red
- High priority: orange
- Medium priority: amber
- Low priority: green
- Resolved/Closed status: green/neutral
- In Progress/Waiting status: blue/amber

Apply the theme consistently to navigation, buttons, KPI cards, grids, charts, dialogs, badges, status indicators, and notifications.

Global requirements:
- Navigation between Dashboard and Tickets
- Active navigation state
- Seed mock tickets once
- Do not duplicate mock data after refresh
- Persist ticket data in LocalStorage
- Confirmation dialog before delete
- Toast/snackbar after create, update, delete, assign, and status change
- Empty states when filters return no results
- Loading states, even if simulated
- Clean models and services
- Data logic separated from UI components
- Responsive enough for a normal laptop screen
- App builds with no errors
- App runs with no browser console errors

Generate all code needed and use Ignite UI Blazor components!!!

# Blazor Grid Overview and Configuration

 
The Blazor Data Grid component is used for displaying large volumes of data.
Modern and more complex grids ensure smooth UX and bring an array of features for
manipulating tabular data. There is an intuitive API, theming, branding,
filtering, sorting, data selection, Excel-style filtering, and many more.


The Ignite UI for Blazor Data Table / Data Grid is a tabular Blazor grid
component that allows you to quickly bind and display your data with little coding or
configuration. Features of the Blazor data grid in our toolbox include filtering,
sorting, templates, row selection, row grouping, row pinning, movable columns,
virtualization, Master-Detail, and much more.


The Blazor tables are optimized for speed and performance, with the ability to
handle millions of rows and columns, and real-time updates in an instant, making
Ignite UI for Blazor Data Grid the best Blazor Data Grid on the market.
